thread:
morgan: Heads-up — ACME Healthcare wants explicit per-tenant audit bundles for HIPAA/BAA. They want signed bundles + retention 7 years. They're asking for SLA clause for evidence delivery. Any blockers from infra/ops?
sara: Ack. Need to confirm whether current audit_event schema includes tenant_id, request_id, resource_owner, action, success/failure, request_payload hashes. Also need KMS-wrapping for signing keys.
dan: Current schema has tenant_id & req_id but payload hashes aren't always emitted (large blob suppression). We can add canonical_hash field. Would need minor agent change in runtime (2-line) and update docs.
kms-bot: Note: signing with HSM-backed key will add ~50ms to pipeline per-bundle if done sync. Consider async bundle creation to avoid tail latency.
morgan: Customer wants live validation API so their auditors can query events compressed bundles with proofs. Also asking for delivery SLA: 24h for evidence export on request, otherwise penalty. Legal flagged.
sara: 24h for on-demand bundle seems heavy. We can offer 'expedited export' paid add-on, default 72h? Need to quantify cost: CPU, storage egress + HSM ops.
dan: For retention 7y, storage cost + immutability requirements. Also FedRAMP-style asks: signed bundle chain, bundle manifests with schema versioning, and ability to redact PII on export.
morgan: How hard is redaction? We already mask certain prompt texts for hosted plans but dedicated/private may want full control.
sara: We'll need RBAC & governance change: only 'audit_admin' role can request unredacted exports. That implies KMS key access gating and audit of export calls.
audit-bot: Suggested event: EXPORT_REQUEST {requester, tenant, scope, artifacts, status}. Must be logged to immutable audit store.
dan: Implementing canonical_hash + signing: runtime emits canonical_hash -> collector batches -> signer plucks batch, signs meta.json {bundle_id, schema_v, count, canonical_hashes[]} -> store. Async means SLA is bounded by batch window.
morgan: Legal wants SLA language: 'bundle delivery within 48 hours for Standard customers; 24 hours for Enterprise with expedited add-on; failure: fee credit up to X.' Need ops validation that 48/24 realistic.
sara: Let's get a back-of-envelope: signing + storing for 1 tenant ~ 200MB compressed, HSM sign 1 signature, packaging job ~ 30s CPU, upload to S3 30s — scale to 10 concurrent requests = ~1-2 min extra, so 24h is doable. But worst-case global outage we need fallback: offer signed snapshot from last 24h instead.
dan: Also need schema version negotiation on export API. Save signed manifests anchored to bundle_id and release tag. Add a manifest field `schema_version` and `tooling_version`.
morgan: Action items: (1) schema PR to add canonical_hash + export metadata (2) ops runbook for expedited export and failure modes (3) pricing draft for expedited SLA (4) KMS gating design + RBAC changes. Who takes what?
sara: I'll take pricing + ops runbook. Will sync with finance.
dan: I'll draft schema PR and sign/pack pipeline proposal. Will include sample manifest JSON and performance benchmarks.
morgan: I'll loop in legal and account team and prep template SLA language. Also ping infra for HSM quotas.
sara: One more: we'll need customer-facing validation tool — small CLI that verifies bundle signature and schema. Could ship as Go binary.
dan: Agree. Add 'bundle-verify' to docs + example: `bundle-verify --manifest manifest.json --signer pubkey.pem`
morgan: thanks. tagging @audit-bot to add incident hook and retention enforcement alert. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: Noted — will create ALERT:retention-mismatch if a tenant's exported retention config drifts from policy.
morgan: OK thanks everyone. I'll follow up with meeting invite for cross-team sync later today.
